name: Gamaliel
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Gamaliel is the one that taught and instructed Paul, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people. If you want this history more in depth, it is in the book of The Complete Works of Flavius Josephus.

note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

points: Then Gamaliel, a Pharisee and a doctor of the law held in reputation among all the people, stood up and commanded the apostles to be put outside a little space.

note.label: Acts 5: All Things Common, and We Ought to Obey God Rather Than Men

points: “Brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel”: Paul came from a high, prestigious family, and he sat and learned under a famous teacher, Gamaliel, a Pharisee. He was “taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers”, a very prestigious background of schooling in the law, born and raised a Pharisee and “zealous toward God”. He was not an idiot who sat down and wrote errors and mistakes into his letters, like some of the idiots say on YouTube.

note.label: PAUL THE PROPHET AND IDOL WORSHIP
